class.name: NNBTIsStateActive
class.brief_description: Condition leaf that checks whether a state tree state is currently active.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] if the [NNSTTickedNodes] at [member state] is active, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] otherwise. Use to coordinate a behaviour tree with a state tree without writing a script.

members.member: Path to the [NNSTTickedNodes] state to check.
